title: Guaranteed Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group
abstract: arXiv:2608.15520v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A multimodal system may begin inference holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state the guarantee conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration normally assumes the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, which policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional guarantees remain valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing with calibration applied at the terminal pattern, and simultaneous certification of complete policy-pattern pairs, which lets calibration data select the deployed policy. A counterexample shows that a guarantee proved for a calibration-independent grouping map need not transfer once the policy makes the terminal group calibration-dependent. translated_title: 保证的自适应模态获取：当策略选择自己的校准组时
translated_abstract: 一个多模态系统可能在推理开始时仅持有部分输入，并可能以一定成本获取其余输入。通过自适应获取，策略决定了最终观察到的输入，因此我们根据该最终输入模式来陈述保证。条件校准通常假设分组映射独立于校准样本固定，而策略诱导的分组不满足此条件。我们刻画了模式条件保证何时仍然有效，并给出了两个有限样本构造：在终端模式上应用校准的无阈值路由，以及完整策略-模式对的同步认证，这允许校准数据选择部署的策略。一个反例表明，对于校准独立的分组映射证明的保证，在策略使终端组依赖校准时不一定能转移。我们将所得方法称为RouteCert。在临床电子健康记录数据上，该方法相比基线方法在保证覆盖率和成本之间实现了更好的权衡。
tldr: 本文提出了RouteCert方法，通过两种有限样本构造（终端模式校准和策略-模式对同步认证），解决了自适应模态获取中策略诱导分组导致的条件校准失效问题，并提供了保证有效性的条件及反例验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RouteCert, which addresses the failure of conditional calibration under policy-induced grouping in adaptive modality acquisition via two finite-sample constructions (terminal-pattern calibration and simultaneous policy-pattern certification), with conditions for guarantee validity and a counterexample.
